label: Graded foundation: positive argument tree and infinitist and coherentist rivals
summary: Analyst warrant assessment; no source read, every literature name below is an unread lead from memory and is not attributed. Positive tree for P (AGWF, J2). Layer 1, verified: P from ascent plus restricted no infinite ascent (see attempt 7b8e8975). Layer 2, verified: ascent from the cause-is-more principle plus the ground-to-esse-cause bridge. Layer 3, existing verified: cause-is-more from cause-has-what-it-gives and the reception-limitation premises (924302df). Layer 2 for no infinite ascent, prose: (i) actuality argument (#310): given ascent, an endless descent of actual grounds is an endless ascent of beings each of which has being only as received (each is grounded, so by the bridge its being is caused by another). The graded framing does not give no-infinite-ascent an independent warrant: by gradedOfActualGroundingWF, the restricted premise with ascent is equivalent to AGWF up to the choice of grade, so its warrant reduces to the actuality argument and the ACT-LIMIT obligation of docs/causal-regress-and-grim-reapers.md. A dense convergent grade (each sustainer strictly more, grades approaching a limit) shows the premise is a real commitment beyond the existence of grades, also under the attribution order (approach to a primary can be infinite); no independent motivation that actual sustainers form such a sequence is recorded, so it is a formal alternative, not an objection. (ii) per se versus per accidens: ascent holds, if at all, for principal simultaneous sustaining of being (the cause gives being while having it not as received from the recipient). In historical succession the earlier cause does not sustain the later and need not be more in being (a child may equal a parent), so an infinite per accidens series has no ascent and no infinite ascent does not exclude it. This is a specific relevant difference explaining why the regress exclusion does not generalize to per accidens series (the distinction usually cited from ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 is an unread lead). (iii) Limits of cause-is-more: the attributed Metaphysics II.1 reading requires synonymy and gives at most at least as such for univocal causes, so strict ascent needs the unrestricted Posterior Analytics strengthening (DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY); equivocal causes satisfy ascent a fortiori (eminent possession); instrumental causes do not: an instrument can contribute beyond its own grade only by the principal agent's power, so the bridge must read the selected relation as principal sustaining. Rivals. R1 compositional (gunk) infinitism (leads Schaffer 2003, Cameron 2008, Morganti 2014, Bliss 2013, Tahko 2014; unread). Target: AGWF through the ascent premise, not no-infinite-ascent: a proper part is not more in being than the whole it composes. Mechanism: wholes existentially depend on proper parts in infinitely divisible matter. Independent justification: conceivability of infinite divisibility and continuum physics (unread; about possibility, while AGWF concerns the actual world). Relevance: only if compositional dependence is the selected support relation and the parts are actual, not potential (the Aristotelian potential-parts reply and priority monism are unread leads); it changes the sense of ground from principal sustaining to composition. Assessment: the strongest standing rival; substantive against the ascent premise under a compositional reading of the support relation, not established as an actual counterexample; price: actual gunky matter with actual parts on which composites depend for existence. R2 grounding infinitism among facts (same leads): changes the relata (facts) and the relation (explanatory determination); not relevant to sustaining support among concreta unless a bridge is supplied. R3 coherentism or interdependence (leads Thompson 2016, Swanson, structural realism; unread). Target: J2 and the mutual-support exclusion. Mechanism: symmetric or cyclic dependence. Relevance: the examples recalled concern identity or nature dependence of relational or structural items, not principal sustaining of concrete existence, and none concerns necessary concreta. Under the graded account the holder must deny rigid ascent: either a necessary being's grade of being differs between worlds, or support between necessary beings runs between equals or from the lesser, which conflicts with cause-has-what-it-gives (376d6a5a) unless that is rejected too. No substantive objection to J2 or rigid ascent meets the standard. R4 unbounded ascent (no greatest possible being; lead unread): targets only the global no-infinite-ascent premise, which quantifies over merely possible candidates; AGWF and J2 need only the restrictions, so it threatens the grade-maximum route and the unification, not the join. Provisional judgment (revisable): the graded route gives AGWF a non-numeric derivation through traditional premises and J2 a principled discriminator against world-varying rivals that no-novel-edge lacked, but it relocates rather than removes the regress question. It raises confidence in the structure of the case, not in AGWF itself.
blocker: Revision conditions: an account on which actual sustaining of concrete existence is compositional and descends without end; a defended non-well-founded actual sustaining chain with an account of how wholly received being is actually exercised (#310); or an independently motivated necessary concretum whose grade of being varies between worlds. Next tests: read one infinitist source (Morganti or Bliss) and one gunk source before citing them; formalize the dense-grade control; check whether the corpus's support relation excludes compositional dependence (DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT).
